text: The subject of Architecture will cultivate high-level professional talents with wide knowledge, solid foundation, high comprehensive and professional quality as well as creativity, who are also well developed in moral, intellectual, fitness and aesthetic perception, to meet the requirements of China’s socialist modernization. The cultivation objectives will emphasize on technical expertise in architecture design, professional quality in town & country planning and landscape architecture design, and extensive occupationaladaptability. The graduates will be capable of engaging in the project planning, project design and construction drawing design work concerning architecture design, town & country planning, landscape architecture design, or engaging in the theoretical work, teaching jobs and management work concerning architecture professionalfield.
